subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened is a Kuo-toan monitor who has experienced enlightenment and now serves as a guide and moral compass for the party, advocating for understanding over violence and emphasizing the legitimacy of the Sea Mother as the traditional faith.
source_quote: Shuushar sighs, 'Such an unnecessary battle. Why would this be happening?'

subject: Ploopploopeen, Archpriest of the Sea Mother
fact: Ploopploopeen is the archpriest of the Sea Mother, a traditional Kuo-toan deity, who seeks to use the party as infiltrators to undermine the cult of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father by offering them as 'token of peace' to her daughter Bloppblippodd.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen explains, 'The Seamother has answered my prayers!'

subject: Bloppblippodd
fact: Bloppblippodd is the daughter of Ploopploopeen and the archpriest of the cult of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father, who has claimed divine vision and amassed followers through increased magical power and bloody sacrifices to the Darklake.
source_quote: A few weeks ago, Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen’s daughter, experienced a powerful vision of 'Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father,' proclaiming him the new god of her people.

subject: The Sea Mother Cult
fact: The Sea Mother Cult is the traditional, long-established faith of the Kuo-toans, centered on harmony, aquatic cycles, and ancestral worship, now threatened by the rise of the Deep Father cult and seeking to reclaim dominance through covert sabotage.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen says, 'The Seamother is not a weird religion. It is the traditional faith of the Kuo-toans!'

subject: The Deep Father Cult
fact: The Deep Father Cult is a new, violent schismatic sect led by Bloppblippodd, which worships Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father through blood sacrifices, chum offerings to the Darklake, and the promise of transcendent power, challenging the Sea Mother’s authority.
source_quote: The followers of the Deep Father have been making an increasing number of offerings on his altar — killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.

subject: Kuo-toan Monitor
fact: A Kuo-toan monitor is a specialized leader who imposes structure and suppresses insanity within Kuo-toan groups; when defeated, the group becomes less cohesive and less likely to continue fighting.
source_quote: A Kuo-Toan monitor is a special kind of Kuo-Toan leader who provides structured organization over a Kuo-Toan group.

subject: Kuo-toan
fact: Kuo-toans are amphibious, fish-like humanoids capable of releasing a viscous, glue-like liquid upon death that causes melee weapons to stick to their bodies, requiring strength to disengage.
source_quote: During the fight, the group discovers that the body of the Kuo-toans releases a particular liquid that causes any melee weapon to stick to their bodies.

subject: Hand-held Crossbows
fact: Hand-held crossbows, when used in coordinated formation by a united team, can generate enough force to take down formidable groups of enemies, suggesting tactical synergy over brute strength.
source_quote: In the end, they realize that a collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down even a formidable group of enemies.

subject: Kuo-toan Schism
fact: A violent schism has erupted among the Kuo-toans between the traditional Sea Mother faith and the new Deep Father cult, leading to internal warfare, sacrificial rituals, and the recruitment of outsiders as pawns.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen explains, 'We are split in two, fighting among ourselves.'

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a mysterious body of water in the Underdark where the Deep Father cult casts bloody chum as offerings, which are consumed by an unseen entity, suggesting a deeper, possibly divine or primordial presence.
source_quote: …casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is a Kuo-toan settlement that has lived in harmonious service to the Sea Mother for generations, now a site of ideological tension and potential battleground between the two cults.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen explains that the inhabitants of Sloobludop have lived in harmonious service to the will of the Sea Mother for some time.

subject: The Deep Father’s True Nature
fact: The origin and nature of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father remain unclear — whether a false god, a primordial entity, or a corrupted manifestation — and the party must determine if the cult is truly evil or merely a new evolution of faith.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen says, 'It is Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father that is the real evil!'

subject: Bloppblippodd’s Vision
fact: The source and validity of Bloppblippodd’s vision of Leemooggoogoon are unknown — was it divine revelation, psychic trauma, or manipulation by an external force? The party may need to confront her directly to uncover the truth.
source_quote: She has backed up her claims with a tremendous increase in magical power, and new followers have flocked to her.

subject: The Unseen Consumer in the Darklake
fact: Something unseen consumes the bloody chum cast into the Darklake — a possible avatar of Leemooggoogoon, a primordial entity, or a trapped god — whose nature may hold the key to ending the schism.
source_quote: …where it is consumed by … something.

subject: The Party’s Role as Infiltrators
fact: The party has been offered as bait by Ploopploopeen to infiltrate the Deep Father cult — their success or failure may determine the balance of power among the Kuo-toans, and their moral alignment may be tested by becoming tools of religious warfare.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen will offer them as a 'token of peace and reconciliation' to get closer to the archpriest of the Deep Father — except the adventurers will not be helpless prisoners but infiltrators.

subject: A few weeks ago
fact: Approximately a few weeks ago, Bloppblippodd experienced her vision of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father, marking the beginning of the schism and the rise of the new cult.
source_quote: A few weeks ago, Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen’s daughter, experienced a powerful vision of 'Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father,' proclaiming him the new god of her people.

subject: An hour from Sloobludop
fact: An hour after the previous encounter, another Kuo-toan party appears — signaling the escalating presence and organization of both factions in the region.
source_quote: An hour from Sloobludop, another kuo-toan party appears.

subject: The Sea Mother’s Followers
fact: The Sea Mother’s followers are traditionalists who revere aquatic harmony, ancestral rites, and structured worship; they are now preparing to strike against the Deep Father cult after years of passive endurance.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen says, 'I will take care of her, and my followers will take care of the followers of this false god.'

subject: The Deep Father’s Followers
fact: The Deep Father’s followers are zealots who embrace blood sacrifice, chaotic magic, and the promise of transcendence through suffering; they are growing in number and power, challenging the old order with violent fervor.
source_quote: New followers have flocked to her.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a pragmatic and impatient member of the party who views the religious conflict as irrelevant drivel and is willing to eliminate the archpriest to end the conversation, showing disdain for ideological entanglements.
source_quote: Daz mutters, 'If Ploopploo-whatever is going to keep talking endlessly like that, maybe we should kill them?'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a humorous, easily amused party member who finds the names and rituals of the Kuo-toans absurd, yet is motivated by tangible rewards and is quick to negotiate for gold and boats.
source_quote: Grygum mutters, 'Oh great, pit one weird religion against another!'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a results-oriented member of the party who focuses on material compensation, pressing the archpriest for rewards and showing little interest in theological debates.
source_quote: Zalthir shouts to the archpriest, 'You said reward?'

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is a disengaged, cynical party member who sees the Kuo-toan conflict as a 'you problem' and questions the party’s involvement, reflecting a detached, survivalist attitude.
source_quote: Topsy asks, 'I hear about your problems, and that sounds like a you problem, not like a me problem. What can we help with you?'

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir is a cautious, questioning member of the party who wonders whether to continue engaging with the Kuo-toans, reflecting the group’s uncertainty about their role in this escalating conflict.
source_quote: Sethir mutters, 'Should we continue?'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a pragmatic and impatient member of the party who views the religious conflict as irrelevant drivel and is willing to eliminate the archpriest to end the conversation, showing disdain for ideological entanglements.
source_quote: Daz mutters, 'If Ploopploo-whatever is going to keep talking endlessly like that, maybe we should kill them?'

subject: School of Kuo-toans
fact: Kuo-toans move in coordinated, fish-like formations, following their leader in circular patterns — a behavior that is both surreal and highly choreographed, suggesting deep social synchronization or psychic resonance.
source_quote: They follow her like a school of fish, walking here and there in circles.

subject: Potions of Healing
fact: Two potions of healing are offered by Ploopploopeen as part of the reward package, indicating the party’s anticipated exposure to combat and injury during the infiltration mission.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing.

subject: Two Boats and Guides
fact: Two boats and experienced guides to navigate the Darklake are offered as part of the reward, essential for the party’s movement through the Kuo-toan-controlled waterways and their infiltration of the Deep Father’s stronghold.
source_quote: 'Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?' The escapees nod in agreement.

subject: Shuushar’s Philosophical Droning
fact: Shuushar’s tendency to speak at length about openness, perspective, and judgment may delay decisive action — the party must decide whether his wisdom is vital or a dangerous distraction.
source_quote: Shuushar continues to drone on but thankfully walks away.

subject: The Daughter’s Loyalty
fact: It is unclear whether Bloppblippodd is truly devoted to Leemooggoogoon or is being manipulated — the party may need to confront her directly to determine if she is a zealot, a pawn, or a victim.
source_quote: She has backed up her claims with a tremendous increase in magical power.
